glossEn: be pertinent or relevant or applicable
note: be pertinent or relevant or applicable。线索：to sth / to a case。The rule does not apply to part-time students.
ask (for something)。线索：for sth（钱、许可、时间）。She applied for a scholarship.

glossEn: refer (a word or name) to a person or thing
note: refer (a word or name) to a person or thing。把某个名称/说法「应用为」某人某物。The explorer first applied the name "New Holland" to this coast.
apply oneself to。线索：oneself + to + 抽象名词。She applied herself to the study of Latin.
